verdicts.reason: A: the white card fills almost the whole canvas, so the desert imagery is reduced to a sliver along the bottom. The logo floats at an arbitrary x-position that doesn't line up with the left-aligned headline, the headline sits close to the left edge, and the small See Fares button is pushed against the far right edge, cut off from the copy. B keeps the desert backdrop and a centered card, but the logo straddles the card's top edge, the card runs into the bottom edge, and the See Fares CTA is shrunk to an illegible pill. A wins narrowly because its call to action is still readable.
